Text: She was tied at the feet, but not the hands.
[slightly delirious]I went there, it should have been easy, the two of them.
Fuck you. Gimme one good reason I should tell you anything.
[sarcastic]If you just feel like punishing someone, there's a place up the street where they can set that up for you.
You shouldn't be here! It's not safe!
I know she's here. You must have seen her. What are the two of you hiding?
[solemn recitation]The gaze of Great Mother Death is always upon us.
[solemn recitation]Her embrace is the silence of the mountain...
[to a child]This is very important. I need you to tell me what you saw.
[solemn recitation]...the heavy peace of the Stone.
Faith deserves... I won't rest until I find her...[can't say the word "body"] the rest of her.
Wait, the Woodsman's still walking the streets?
Wait, the big fat guy's still walking the streets?
There are going to be more, aren't there.
You shouldn't be here! It's not safe!
A serial killer!  Oh, God, and it's one of us!
We've got to put a lid on this! If you can't manage it, I'll find someone who can!
Does it matter? Maybe you just want to punish someone. We can arrange that.
Friend on friend, at the end of the end...
You're a monster! A goddamn monster!
I found out where she's been staying.
